title: Electrical: published business-contact discovery with license-field safeguards
hypothesis: A published electrical-contractor business number can start a business-contact workflow, but Texas TDLR Electrical Contractor owner_name and owner_telephone fields do not independently establish an owner or a second/direct phone. Deliver only after the existing permitted-contact gates and separate owner evidence pass.
ownerSource: Texas TDLR Electrical Contractor rows can qualify a licensed electrical business, but the observed owner_name equaled business_name in all 10 sampled rows, so it is business identity rather than owner evidence.
phoneSource: Texas TDLR Electrical Contractor business_telephone is a published business-contact candidate. In the observed rows owner_telephone exactly mirrored it, so it must not be treated as an additional or owner phone.

workflow.label: Discover electrical businesses
workflow.detail: Use the live recipe-A electrical query and require an electrical core term.

workflow.label: Electrical relevance
workflow.detail: Accept electrician, electrical, or electrical-contractor evidence; reject generic contractors and adjacent-only generator, solar, lighting, or low-voltage businesses.

workflow.label: Optional Texas license cross-check
workflow.detail: Use an active Electrical Contractor row as business and license evidence only; do not infer a person from owner_name.

workflow.label: Published business phone present?
workflow.detail: Use business_telephone once. owner_telephone is a mirrored field in the observed sample, not an independent phone source.

workflow.label: Hold: no permitted contact
workflow.detail: Do not append or infer a phone from a license identity row.

workflow.label: Verify permitted business contact
workflow.detail: Apply line-type, live, DNC, and global delivery-dedupe checks.

workflow.label: Independent owner evidence?
workflow.detail: A license field named owner_name, a business name, or a shared office phone alone does not establish ownership of the business or handset.

workflow.label: Hold business contact
workflow.detail: Keep a non-owner business-contact classification when independent owner evidence is absent.

workflow.label: Deliver approved contact
workflow.detail: Deliver only after all gates pass; owner-confirmed mobile requires separate evidence.

edges.label: line-type, live, DNC, and dedupe passed

failures.risk: TDLR owner_name is represented as a named owner.
failures.mitigation: Treat owner_name as unverified business identity when it duplicates business_name; require independent person/ownership evidence before owner labeling.

failures.risk: TDLR owner_telephone is counted as a second or direct owner phone.
failures.mitigation: Normalize and retain one phone candidate per matching business_telephone/owner_telephone pair before verification and delivery dedupe.

failures.risk: Adjacent generator, solar, lighting, or low-voltage businesses are admitted as electrical contractors.
failures.mitigation: Require an electrical core term or matching electrical license class; send adjacent-only rows to review or rejection.

failures.risk: Florida electrical requests use a register configuration that claims a phone column absent from the extract.
failures.mitigation: Route Florida electrical register rows as identity-only and require a separately published business contact before verification.

sources.label: TX TDLR All Licenses: Electrical Contractor
sources.scope: Texas published electrical-contractor business identities and phone fields

sources.label: Florida DBPR construction and electrical extract
sources.scope: Florida electrical qualifier candidates without phone fields

iterations.hypothesis: Texas Electrical Contractor owner fields might identify an owner and an additional direct phone.
iterations.test: Free aggregate-only live query of 10 Electrical Contractor rows on 2026-09-24.
iterations.observed: 10/10 had business_name, owner_name, business_telephone, and owner_telephone; business_name equaled owner_name in 10/10, and business_telephone equaled owner_telephone in 10/10.
iterations.change: Classify both owner fields as non-independent in this route; keep one business-phone candidate and require separate owner evidence.

measurement.result: TX TDLR 7358-krk7 Electrical Contractor filter: business_name 10/10; owner_name 10/10; business_telephone 10/10; owner_telephone 10/10; business_name exactly equaled owner_name 10/10; business_telephone exactly equaled owner_telephone 10/10. Aggregate evidence only; no contact values retained. It does not measure mobile, live, DNC, owner confirmation, or delivery.

cost.note: No delivered owner contact was measured. Historical electrical brain rates use a different denominator and remain outside this review.

implementation.summary: The runtime recognizes electrical relevance and applies downstream contact gates, but no dedicated TX Electrical Contractor adapter exists. The Florida contractor profile incorrectly states that DBPR extract rows include a phone although flDbprRecord has no phone column, and its ordered aliases make equivalent Florida electrical phrasing route differently.

nextMeasurement: With synthetic rows, verify that Texas mirrored owner telephone fields collapse to one phone candidate and cannot yield an owner label; verify that Florida electrical wording resolves independent of word order and that FL DBPR rows without a separate published business phone enter a hold branch. Then run an authorized outcome pilot measuring line type, DNC, reachability, and owner confirmation separately.
